description: maintenance-verbs M1+M2.2. Reads back a rotate_session, restart_session, or generate_curation_report job's ledger status (queued/processing/completed/error), its progress_percent (one update per leg), and on a terminal status the worker's own result or error payload. A generic AsyncJobManager job-row reader, not scoped to any one action name. These jobs configure no completion_handlers, so this poll is the ONLY way a direct caller learns the outcome — the dispatch verb's own return value only confirms the job was queued, never that the work finished.
embedding_description: Poll the outcome of a rotate_session, restart_session, or generate_curation_report job by job_id — the caller-side status check for an async fleet-management or memory-curation job, the same pattern as ComfyUI's check_generation_status for image jobs. Use this after any of those three dispatch verbs, never assume their own dispatch response means the work is done.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: job_id, status, progress_percent, and (on a terminal status) result or error — result carries action-specific fields: turn_observed/new_claude_session_ids for a rotation; old_agent_instance_id/new_agent_instance_id/role_reclaim_verified for a restart; demotion_candidates/unresolved_lines/head_bytes/head_lines/byte_budget/line_budget/over_budget for a curation report.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Lead with status. If still queued/processing, say so plainly and suggest polling again rather than treating silence as failure. If error, surface the error code/message verbatim — a verify_timeout error means the choreography ran but could not confirm its own outcome (ARMED, not necessarily FIRED), which is different from a hard failure earlier in the sequence.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: A read of one AsyncJobManager job row by job_id, plus its terminal result/error payload if the status warrants it.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: missing_argument: job_id was empty. job_not_found: no job exists for that id (typo, or the job predates this solet's current job table). async_job_manager_unavailable: the platform's AsyncJobManager is not bound on this solet.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: For job_not_found, confirm the job_id came from a real rotate_session/restart_session/generate_curation_report dispatch response, not a guessed or reconstructed value.
